# Scythes :

Scythes adds a new set of craftable scythes to Minecraft, providing an alternative farming and harvesting tool that fits naturally into vanilla progression.

Available Scythes
Wooden Scythe
Stone Scythe
Iron Scythe
Golden Scythe
Diamond Scythe
Netherite Scythe

All scythes can be crafted using vanilla materials and are balanced to match their corresponding tool tiers.

![How to Craft the Scythes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5d87ed0a901505456e99d1b25239e3ad776c51a.png)








Each scythe tier has a different harvesting radius:

Wooden Scythe: 2×2 area
Stone Scythe: 3×3 area
Iron Scythe: 3×3 area
Golden Scythe: 5×5 area
Diamond Scythe: 5×5 area
Netherite Scythe: 5×5 area

When used on fully grown crops, the scythe harvests all crops within its area of effect in a single action.

Features
Fully craftable in Survival mode

Vanilla-style progression

Custom textures

Supports multiple languages
